submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole is a retrospective firearms/hunting detector: it peaks on the trigger token itself ('rifle', 'gun', 'pistol', 'ammunition', 'gunshot', 'hunting'/'hunter'), firing at 3.4-7.5 on firearms text versus weak background (at most 0.57, under a tenth of true max) on the scan's generic top examples, which contain no firearms vocabulary; suppressed-list tokens ('maths', 'colours', 'learnt') sit at floor. It predicts no specific upcoming token: the Jacobian-promoted firearms list coincides with its own triggers, attribution is local to the peak (mean distance 1.3 tokens), and it fires on rather than before topic words.
